title: Expedition 33 Side Quests - Complete List & Guide
description: Complete list of all side quests in Expedition 33 including Nevron quests, Gestral Games, Paint Cages, Lost Gestrals, and Painting Workshop locations.

sections.title: Side Quest Overview
sections.content:
Expedition 33 features a variety of optional side content beyond the main story. Unlike traditional quest logs, many activities are discovered through exploration rather than being explicitly marked. Side content rewards include weapons, Pictos, cosmetics, crafting materials, and trophies.

Types of Side Content

  • Nevron Quests (10 total): Help friendly Nevron creatures with their requests for unique rewards
  • Gestral Games: Challenge Gestral fighters in solo combat encounters
  • Paint Cages: Locked containers requiring you to destroy specific targets to open
  • Lost Gestrals: Hidden creatures to find and return to Camp
  • Painting Workshop: Create art from materials gathered during exploration
  • Relationship Events: Character-specific side content tied to relationship levels

When to Do Side Content

Most side content can be completed at any point after discovering it, and all areas remain accessible after the story ends. However, some quests have prerequisites (like swimming or Esquie mount access), so naturally revisit areas as you gain new abilities. The only truly missable side content relates to specific camp interactions tied to trophies.

sections.title: Gestral Games
sections.content:
Gestral Games are combat challenges where you fight Gestral warriors in specialized solo encounters. They primarily occur in Gestral Village but expand to other locations later.

Gestral Village Arena

The Hidden Gestral Arena offers four solo fights against unique Gestral champions:

  • Bertrand Big Hands — solo fight, Level 15
  • Dominique Giant Feet — solo fight, Level 15
  • Julien Tiny Head — solo fight, Level 15
  • Matthieu The Colossus — solo fight, Level 15

Final Arena Fight (Critical)

The Arena's final challenge lets you choose which character to fight with. Choose Maelle — winning as Maelle rewards Medalum, her best early-game weapon. Winning as Lune gives Trebuchim (available elsewhere). You can also choose to fight as Lune if you missed the Sanctuary version.

Gestral Merchants

Several Gestrals throughout the game offer combat-gated shops — you must defeat them in a fight before they'll sell to you:

  • Gestral Merchant (Gestral Village) — sells Demonam after defeating
  • Eesda (Gestral Village) — sells Sekarum after defeating
  • Mandelgo (Old Lumiere) — sells Algueron after defeating
  • Blooraga (Visages) — sells Sadon after defeating
  • Grour (Renoir's Drafts) — sells Charnon after defeating

sections.title: Paint Cages
sections.content:
Paint Cages are locked containers scattered throughout dungeons and the overworld. Each requires you to find and destroy specific targets nearby to break the cage open.

How Paint Cages Work

  • Look for painted metal cage structures containing visible items
  • Nearby you'll find destructible targets — red balloons, paint locks, or breakable objects
  • Destroy all targets to shatter the cage and collect the reward
  • Some targets require specific abilities (Paint Break, shooting, Esquie)

Notable Paint Cage Rewards

Tips

  • Mark cage locations you cannot open yet — return when you gain Paint Break or other abilities
  • Red balloons are often hidden above or behind the cage structure — look up and around corners
  • Some cages require Esquie's abilities to reach the targets

sections.title: Lost Gestrals
sections.content:
Lost Gestrals are small hidden creatures scattered across every region of The Continent. Finding them and returning them to Camp earns rewards and contributes to the "Savior" trophy.

How It Works

  • Lost Gestrals appear as small, often camouflaged creatures in hard-to-reach spots
  • Interact with them to "rescue" them — they then appear back at Camp
  • Speak to the Gestral caretaker at Camp to receive your reward
  • Rewards scale with the number returned: materials → Pictos → rare items

Where to Look

  • Behind waterfalls: Check behind every waterfall in Flying Waters and elsewhere
  • Elevated platforms: Requires Esquie's jumping abilities to reach
  • Underwater areas: Only accessible after gaining swim ability in Stone Wave Cliffs
  • Hidden paths: Crouching passages, breakable walls, and obscured routes
  • Cliff edges: Walk along every ledge in mountainous areas

Region Distribution

Lost Gestrals are distributed across all major areas. Each region contains 2-4 Gestrals on average. Revisit earlier areas after gaining Esquie mount and swim ability — several are specifically gated behind these movement upgrades.

sections.title: Painting Workshop
sections.content:
The Painting Workshop is a crafting side activity where you use gathered pigments and materials to create artwork. This system ties into the game's artistic themes and provides unique rewards.

How the Workshop Operates

  • Access the Workshop at Camp once unlocked (after Flying Waters)
  • Gather pigment materials from enemies, bosses, and exploration
  • Combine specific pigments to create paintings
  • Completed paintings provide permanent stat bonuses or unlock Lumina effects

Material Sources

  • Common pigments: Drop from regular enemies throughout all areas
  • Rare pigments: Found in chests, as boss drops, or from specific Chromatic enemies
  • Unique pigments: Tied to specific optional bosses or quest completions

Workshop Rewards

Paintings created at the Workshop provide various benefits:

  • Permanent stat increases for chosen party members
  • Unique Lumina effects not available from Pictos
  • Cosmetic camp decorations
  • Contributes to collectible completion percentages

sections.title: Other Optional Content
sections.content:
Beyond the major side quest categories, Expedition 33 includes additional optional activities throughout the game.

Relationship Events

  • Build relationships with party members through camp conversations between story beats
  • Each character has 5 relationship levels with unique scenes and bonuses
  • Maximum relationship with Maelle unlocks The Reacher dungeon (contains Lithum weapon)
  • Relationship events provide Music Records and background lore

Overworld Exploration

  • Esquie abilities: Unlock new terrain types (jumping gaps, breaking obstacles, sprinting)
  • Hidden caves: Many unmarked entrances across The Continent leading to optional bosses or treasures
  • Crimson Forest: Late-game exploration area with the Chromatic Gold Chevaliere
  • Frozen Hearts: High-level optional area near Monoco's Station

Cosmetic Content

  • Outfits: Found from Mimes, shops, and specific quest completions
  • Hairstyles: Primarily from Mime defeats
  • Swimsuits: Found at Gestral Beach in Gestral Village
  • Grandis Fashionist: Sells unique outfits at Monoco's Station

Carousel (Monoco's Station)

An interactive area with mini-games and unique item rewards. Explore thoroughly for hidden collectibles and character-specific interactions. The Carousel ties into Monoco's personal story.
